justification: `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/WordUtils.java` is a 717-line utility class with 10 public static methods spanning several distinct concerns: capitalization/uncapitalization (`capitalize`, `capitalizeFully`, `uncapitalize`), initials extraction (`initials`), case swapping (`swapCase`), word search (`containsAllWords`), and text wrapping (`wrap`), plus only one small private helper (`isDelimiter`). `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/WordUtilsTest.java` treats these as separate behaviors, which is evidence of multiple responsibilities and low cohesion, so the class could be split into smaller abstractions.
